name: report_code_bug

input.test: REQ-010 AC2: A change that violates the overlap rule or time slot rules is rejected and the original booking stays unchanged
input.explanation: PUT /api/bookings/:id moving a booking from 12:00-13:00 to 10:30-11:30 overlaps another booking (10:00-11:00) in the same room, but the server answered 200 instead of 400. The overlap rule (REQ-003) is not enforced on a time change. Test setup is valid and the expectation follows the criterion.
input.proposedFix: In BookingService.changeTime, run the rule check and overlap lookup against the other bookings in the room, excluding only the booking being changed. Throw an Error on overlap, and make the update atomic so the original booking stays unchanged. Check that findOverlapping/update do not ignore other bookings, for example through a wrong exclude-id comparison.

text:
I found one failing test and it is a code bug. I changed no test files and did not re-run typecheck or the tests.

The failing test is REQ-010 AC2 in `test/UC-004.test.ts`. It creates two bookings in the same room, 10:00–11:00 and 12:00–13:00. It then moves the second to 10:30–11:30, which overlaps the first. The server answered 200 where the criterion requires a rejection (400), so the overlap rule is not enforced when a booking's time is changed.

I reported it with a proposed fix: the time-change path in `BookingService.changeTime` should run the overlap check against the room's other bookings, excluding only the booking being changed. It should also keep the update atomic so the original booking stays unchanged.
